model.file: 02_人体骨骼晶格肌肉方案/输出/channel_first/elastic_conduit_bench/FJ1468_E5_T5_ds5_dt2e-05.xml

specification.damping_scaling: Inverse segment length: rotational reference 3e-5 Nms/rad and axial reference 0.5 Ns/m at 5 mm; uncalibrated
specification.inertia_model: Lumped node masses from adjacent half-segments, isotropic nodal rotary inertia; clamped root half-segment mass omitted from moving system
specification.limit_note: Numerical protection only, not a proposed physical stroke stop
specification.boundary_conditions: Proximal position and first-segment orientation fixed; distal position soft-constrained, orientation free. No intermediate world-fixed nodes.

scope: Isolated supported-guide sensitivity bench, NOT whole-arm motion or final hardware approval. No friction, bone contact, cross-section ovalisation, shear, self-contact, measured TPU material or fitted end connectors. Active input is prescribed cable tension, not prescribed pose.
cable_model: Uniform nonnegative pulling tension on a tendon through dynamically moving beam nodes. Beam axial and rotational springs carry guide reaction. Intermediate nodes are never fixed to world. Slipping/friction and separate cable slack are not modelled in this bench.
